description:
You already know what you should be doing. Daily Leveling makes doing it count.

Every task becomes a quest worth XP. Every long-term push becomes a goal. Everything you finish feeds seven stats — fitness, health, business, finance, education, personal, and travel — so you can see at a glance where you're strong and where you've been coasting.

This connector deletes the worst part: writing it all down. Talk through your week and the things you commit to become real quests, no retyping. Say you finished the workout and it's marked done, XP awarded, streak advanced. Ask where you stand and you get actual numbers back, not a guess.

What it can do:
• Turn anything you mention into a quest, with category, priority, and deadline
• Mark quests complete and award the XP that comes with them
• Set longer-horizon goals and break them down into quests
• Search everything you've saved and pull any of it up in full
• Report your XP, your level, and your progress across all seven stats

It only ever touches the quests, goals, and XP of the account that authorized it — never your password, never your email, never anyone else's data. Revoke access any time from your assistant's settings.

Daily Leveling is free on iOS and Android.
